#!/bin/bash
# flux: job specification translated from pbs

# Resource requests
#FLUX -t 72:00:00
#FLUX -N 1
#FLUX -n 24
#FLUX --gpus-per-node=4
#FLUX --exclusive

# Job metadata and accounting
#FLUX -J ResIm10E1
#FLUX -q standard
#FLUX --account=MHPCC96650NRL

# Output options
#FLUX --output=job.out
#FLUX --error=job.out
# NOTE: PBS option '-j oe' (join stdout/stderr) is handled by directing stdout and stderr to the same file.

# Translated site-specific resource
# NOTE: The PBS resource 'powerai=on' is translated to a generic resource request.
# This requires the Flux instance to be configured with a resource named 'powerai'.
#FLUX --requires=powerai

# NOTE: PBS option '-V' (export all environment variables) is the default behavior in Flux and requires no directive.
# NOTE: PBS option 'place=scatter' is not applicable to a single node job.


. /usr/share/Modules/init/sh
module load glog/0.3.3
module load gflags/2.2.0

export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$LD_LIBRARY_PATH:/gpfs/pkgs/mhpcc/protobuf/lib:/gpfs/pkgs/mhpcc/boost/lib:/gpfs/pkgs/mhpcc/lmdb/lib:/gpfs/pkgs/mhpcc/leveldb/lib:/gpfs/pkgs/mhpcc/opencv-3.4.0/lib64

cd /gpfs/scratch/lnsmith/deepLearning/caffe/9-11-17/

./examples/bk_imagenet/queues/resnet/btrain4.sh

# NOTE: The 'qsub' command has been translated to 'flux submit'. The submitted
# job script 'mbqsub4.pbs' may also need to be converted to the Flux format.
flux submit ./examples/bk_imagenet/queues/resnet/mbqsub4.pbs

exit
#module use $PROJECTS_HOME/datools/modulefiles
#module load anaconda/2
#module load caffe/5.0
#module list

#cd /gpfs/scratch/lnsmith/deepLearning/fewTrainingData/imagenet

#./examples/bk_imagenet/train.sh

issues: The script requests 24 tasks (`-n 24`) but launches the application (`./examples/bk_imagenet/queues/resnet/btrain4.sh`) without a parallel launcher like `flux run`. This will result in the application running on only a single core, leaving the other 23 allocated tasks idle.

The script submits a new job from within the current job (`flux submit ./.../mbqsub4.pbs`). This nested submission creates a separate, independent job that will not use the resources of the parent job. This is often not the intended behavior.

The script submitted via `flux submit` is a PBS script (`mbqsub4.pbs`). It will likely fail or run incorrectly as it has not been converted to the Flux job specification format. The `#PBS` directives within it will be ignored.
